Publications and reports

Publications and reports

We create a wide range of publications and reports at Kāinga Ora. See below for the full list.

Core publications

Our core publications explain what we plan to do, how we are performing, and how we measure our success. They include our Strategy, Statement of Intent, Statement of Performance Expectations, and Annual Reports.

In this Section
  • Annual Report
  • Statement of Intent
  • Statement of Performance Expectations
  • Kāinga Ora Strategy
Tracking our performance

Explore how we are performing across tenancy management, delivering new and improved housing, managing our homes, reducing costs and strengthening our financial sustainability.

In this Section

OIA and proactive releases

Kāinga Ora proactively publishes a variety of information which includes responses to selected Official Information Act (OIA) requests, quarterly housing statistics and other proactive releases including Cabinet papers.

In this Section
  • Housing statistics
  • Responses to OIA requests
  • Chief Executive's expense reports
  • Proactive releases
  • Gender and Ethnic Pay Gap Action Plan
Build partner publications

Kāinga Ora values our relationships with our suppliers and build partners. We proactively publish guides to ensure build projects meet our standards and reflect our design principles, and we are committed to keeping our partners informed with news and industry updates.

In this Section
